headline: Angel One releases eight stock recommendations for Samvat 2083
hook: Brokerage picks for the new Samvat year
summary: Angel One has identified eight stocks for the upcoming Samvat 2083, projecting potential upsides of up to 32%. The list includes ICICI Bank, Northern Arc Capital, Aarti Pharmalabs, Shanti Gold International, Ratnaveer Precision Engineering, Engineers India, AGI Infra, and Apollo Micro Systems. These recommendations are timed for the traditional Muhurat trading session. Retail investors should note these are broker-specific research calls.
why_it_matters: Brokerage research may influence short-term price action for these specific stocks.

headline: Apollo Micro Systems posts strong Q2 results as Systematix maintains Buy call with Rs570 target
summary: Apollo Micro Systems reported a 72.2% jump in revenue and a 55.6% increase in net profit year-on-year for the second quarter. Following the earnings, brokerage Systematix retained its Buy rating on the stock with a target price of Rs570. The brokerage cited strong growth prospects and anticipated order inflows of Rs120 billion over the next two years. The defence stock has delivered a multi-bagger return over the past five years.
whats_next: Order inflow milestones over the next two years
why_it_matters: Brokerage optimism may sustain momentum in your small-cap defence holdings
winners_losers: Apollo Micro Systems shareholders gain / none hurt

headline: Defence stocks rally as government clears major procurement proposals
hook: Massive ₹2.12 lakh crore defence procurement approved
summary: The Defence Acquisition Council has approved procurement proposals worth ₹2.12 lakh crore to boost domestic manufacturing. Approximately 82% of this total value is reserved for Indian industry players. Shares of companies like Apollo Micro, Paras Defence, BEL, and HAL rose by up to 9% following the announcement. Brokerages anticipate a robust medium-term order pipeline for these firms.
whats_next: Conversion of procurement proposals into formal government contracts
why_it_matters: Domestic defence manufacturers gain long-term revenue visibility and order growth.
winners_losers: Domestic defence manufacturers gain / No clear losers

headline: Apollo Micro Systems shares surge 8.5% after strong Q2 results and record order book
hook: Record order book powers defensive rally
summary: Apollo Micro Systems shares rose 8.5% on Tuesday following a 55.6% year-on-year increase in net profit to ₹48.4 crore for the September quarter. Revenue grew 72.2% to ₹388 crore, while the company's order book reached a record ₹1,765 crore. The stock is up 60% in 2026 amid a broader quarterly rally in defence sector equities. Retail investors holding the stock see strong fundamental growth backed by execution visibility.
whats_next: Watch key technical levels for further momentum.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings validate stellar defence sector valuations.
